status: declared before new model fitting or validation scores
hypotheses: Exact ISO country aliases recover candidates lost to spelling differences without dropping all country constraints.
Legal-form-aware, abbreviation and train-only rare-token features improve company pair ranking and reduce false matches.
A validation-selected threshold and Platt calibration can fail under dataset shift; test this explicitly.

data.development: Existing immutable MaDI train and validation partitions from madi_companies_v1
data.replay: MaDI test has already been inspected; all new results are exploratory replay, never an independent confirmation.
data.external: NIST FEIII 2016 official FFIEC-LEI and FFIEC-SEC explicitly adjudicated pairs, zero-shot transfer of all frozen MaDI models and policies. No FEIII training, tuning, calibration or model selection.
data.external_labels: TP=1, TN=0, Ambiguous excluded from confusion counts and separately counted; all unadjudicated pairs unknown.
data.external_scope: Supplied-pair classification only. Expert candidate sampling does not support population accuracy or full-universe blocking recall. Historical 2016 data is not a future-time holdout.
data.external_overlap: Report conservative sensitivity excluding pairs with any exact normalized-name overlap with MaDI train/validation. This is not proof of legal-entity disjointness.
data.identifiers: Opaque source IDs for joins only, no LEI/CIK/registration identifiers as features. No cleaned-name, former-name, relationship, or finance columns.
data.contradictions: Quarantine contradictory known-positive components and all incident pairs; never relabel.
data.raw_distribution: Local only; publish aggregates and hashes, no raw data or per-pair predictions.

feiii_projection.ffiec: original institution name/address/city/zip; country absent, never inferred
feiii_projection.sec: CONFORMED_NAME, B_STREET/B_CITY/B_POSTAL/B_COUNTRY; business versus legal address mismatch remains a limitation

models.legacy_lr: Existing fixed C=1 logistic baseline, fit on MaDI train only
models.iso_lr: Same 11 features and C=1 logistic except country conflict uses pycountry exact ISO lookup
models.company_lr: ISO 11 features plus fixed legal-base similarities, legal-form removal indicators, token Jaccard, train-IDF weighted Jaccard, abbreviation, length ratio, numeric-token conflict; C=1 logistic
models.company_gb: Same company features; sklearn GradientBoostingClassifier, 100 trees, max_depth=2, min_samples_leaf=10, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=20260915, no hyperparameter search
models.legal_forms: cleanco 2.3; retain original-name features alongside legal-base features; removal alone never implies identity
models.country: pycountry 24.6.1 exact alpha_2/alpha_3/numeric/name/official_name/common_name aliases after existing text normalization. No fuzzy search, inferred subdivisions, hand-tuned test aliases, or territory collapsing.
models.neural: No additional Ditto training in this round; previous three-seed negative result remains unchanged.

development.calibration_partition: MaDI validation dependency groups assigned by SHA256('calibration-v1:' + group_id) parity; parity 0 fits Platt only, parity 1 selects policies/models. No group crosses halves.
development.calibration: One monotonic Platt logistic C=1 fit on raw logit with calibration half labels only. If slope <=0 or either class has <20 pairs, retain identity calibration with explicit reason. Raw and calibrated Brier/ECE both reported.
development.selection: Choose one of the four models by maximum known positives at budget 100 on supplied policy-validation pairs; tie by lower 10FP+FN cost, then higher AP, then declared model order. Report all four models regardless of winner.
development.thresholds: F1 and cost=10FP+FN chosen on policy-validation only; conservative ties prefer reject_all then higher threshold. Neither is an automatic merge policy.
development.fit_budget: Exactly four fits and at most four one-dimensional calibration fits; no retries for better scores. Implementation defects require an explicit invalidated-run record.
development.candidate_validation_cohort: Only endpoints of policy-half labels enter development retrieval; calibration endpoints are excluded from policy retrieval. Report this adjudication-selected cohort; no population precision claims.

retrieval.settings: Reuse immutable MaDI train-fitted character TF-IDF, symmetric top_k=10, min_similarity=0.2; no vocabulary/IDF refit on development or test.
retrieval.policy: hybrid_iso changes only candidate-country comparison; hybrid_soft removes country only during retrieval; scores receive original features.
retrieval.sources: Forbes-DBpedia and Forbes-FullContact separately, then union; no DBpedia-FullContact labels inferred.
retrieval.unknowns: Unknown pairs consume budget; never treat them as negatives. No confidence interval for full-candidate benefit with unknown labels.

evaluation.primary: Known positives captured at supplied-pair review budget 100
secondary: training/scoring elapsed time and model size
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 paired dependency-component bootstrap replicates, seed=20260915; compare validation-selected model with legacy_lr at budget100/F1/cost. Conditional fixed-model intervals, not repeated-training uncertainty. No statistical win if interval crosses zero.
evaluation.external_reports: Report FFIEC-LEI and FFIEC-SEC separately plus overlap-excluded sensitivity. Never select a model based on external scores.
evaluation.freeze: Save model/input/source hashes, selected model and thresholds before scoring MaDI replay or reading FEIII projected name/address features.

integration: Opt-in ISO candidates and frozen company model in API/worker/CLI/UI. Company and ISO candidate runs are review-only, full recompute, frozen pipeline/model fingerprints, never automatic publication or merge.
completion: Implement, run finite comparisons, record negative findings, run affected/full regression and publication checks. Human author understanding and real user acceptance are separate and cannot be completed by automation.
